entities.summary: Robin Norell is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman for the Iserlohn Roosters of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Norell was selected by the Chicago Blackhawks in the fourth round of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
